finding: In preterm infants, feeding with breast milk was associated with a more gradual acquisition of intestinal microbial diversity and a microbiome composition that was less influenced by birth weight compared to formula feeding.
mod_finding: This study found that mode of birth influences the intestinal microbiome in preterm infants, with infants who were fed breast milk having a greater initial bacterial diversity and a more gradual acquisition of diversity compared to infants who were fed infant formula.
